label: Radioactivity_content_of_TC99SF
definition: Radioactivity content of Technetium-99 in sea water from discharges of the nuclear fuel reprocessing plant at Sellafield, UK. Technetium-99 is a radioactive isotope of element Technetium, with a half-life of about 211k years. Units: Becquerel per kilogram (Bq kg-1).
